displayPattern: Shown on the control board 7-segment display: EEL
causes: Igniter relay fault on integrated control module
diySteps: Technician: check and correct wiring from control to igniter
Technician: diagnose and replace a shorted igniter
Technician: verify and correct unit ground wiring
Technician: check igniter output from control; replace control if necessary
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: igniter circuit diagnosis requires live electrical testing.
